replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a way to reduce the dimensionality of data. You start by standardizing the data. Then, you calculate the covariance matrix. Next, you find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix. You sort the eigenvalues in descending order and choose the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. You can then project the data onto these components. As for the math, it's complex, but you don't need to understand all of it to use PCA.
